# Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

Works in this collection use states or trajectories generated by the current or near-current student and direct supervision from multiple independently identifiable teachers. Method papers, analyses, and system reports share one collection; record type is a separate facet.

**47 records · metadata verified through 2026-09-08 · [Taxonomy](../resources/taxonomy.md)**
